digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift workflow and Gerrit CI bridge
propositions: terraform-drift.yml workflow does not run on Gerrit changes because it only triggers on pull_request and push to main, not Gerrit submissions
unapplied terraform resources can pass Verified gates and land to main because the drift check runs post-merge rather than pre-submit
a change touching infra/terraform/** receives Verified +1 without proof its declared resources exist in the target infrastructure
the drift check must distinguish between a change's own not-yet-applied additions (acceptable) and previously-committed HCL that was never applied (defect)
autodeploy does not invoke terraform apply, so manual applies are required but not enforced or documented as a landing requirement
